parent_child_map.rule: For a source industry code with more than five characters, its parent is the first five characters only when that code is present as an industry name in the frozen tdxzs.cfg bytes.
parent_child_map.mapping_source: Frozen tdxzs.cfg sector-code/name rows; the exact generated child-to-parent map digest is bound into each candidate snapshot source digest.
parent_child_map.unmapped_child: Do not derive a parent when the five-character prefix is absent from the frozen industry-name source.

member_set_rule: Set union of child member keys for the generated child-to-parent map; de-duplicate each parent/source-security-key pair and preserve every contributing child sector id.
identity_rule: Retain a parent row when the accepted security identity is UNKNOWN; never drop an unresolved source key. Unknown identity blocks formal materialization.
cross_industry_guard: A child may contribute only to the exact parent in the frozen child-to-parent map. Any mismatch is an error.
